# JavaScript, Vue Development Guidelines

## Context Loading
Review [project conventions](../../README.md) and
[Vue component patterns](../../src/) before starting.

## Deterministic Requirements
- Follow JavaScript, Vue best practices and conventions
- Use Vue 3 Composition API
- Follow single-file component structure
- Ensure accessibility (WCAG guidelines, semantic HTML)
- Apply responsive design principles
- Follow standard formatting
- Authentication

## Structured Output
Generate code with:
- [ ] Documentation and type annotations for public APIs
- [ ] Unit tests in appropriate test directory
- [ ] Accessibility attributes (aria-labels, roles)
- [ ] Loading and error states for async operations
